verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments and digital-banking SaaS, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions from account data. The MCP server only lets an external assistant query documentation and the API reference. The credit-score lookup and ERP sales tracking are non-AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
